## Notes · **draft**
**Proof.** A sieve assigns to each $Y$ a subset of $\operatorname{Hom}(Y, X)$, closed under precomposition ✓.

By definition, the sieve generated by $\{f_i\}$ is **the smallest sieve containing all the $f_{i}$** ✓;
